# Design Plus — Architecture & Structural Engineering Studio, Ajmer (Rajasthan, India)

> Design Plus is a chartered architecture + structural engineering studio based in
> Ajmer, Rajasthan. Founded 2004. Led by Er. Sudhir Soni (Chartered Engineer,
> Principal Structural Engineer) and Ar. Vipul Verma (Principal Architect).
> The studio designs custom residences, commercial complexes, farmhouses and public
> infrastructure across Ajmer, Jaipur, Pushkar, Kishangarh, Bhilwara, Udaipur and
> Rajasthan — and executes turnkey projects with in-house structural rigor.

## Contact (official)
- Studio: Rajeev Marg, Panchsheel Nagar, Ajmer, Rajasthan 305004, India
- Phone: +91 79764 53090, +91 94614 65610
- Email: designplusajmer@gmail.com
- Hours: Mon–Sat, 09:30–19:30 IST
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/architectsdesignplus/
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/share/19cizaeGBa/

## What the studio does
- Architectural design: bespoke residences, villas, farmhouses, commercial & retail,
  interiors, concept & climate studies
- Structural engineering: RCC & steel detailing, structural drawings, bar bending
  schedules (BBS), chartered stability certificates, seismic-resistant design
- Turnkey project management consultancy (PMC): contractor oversight, quality &
  quantity control, site execution
- Specialities: Vastu-compliant house plans, ADA (Ajmer Development Authority)
  building-plan sanction assistance, 3D elevation & 2D floor-plan design,
  topographical survey, geotechnical consultancy, valuation
- Products: 44-item catalog of architectural supplies & building materials
  (tensile structures, construction chemicals, steel & reinforcement, survey
  instruments, water solutions, panels & prefab, concrete & masonry, interiors)
